eps.t: I'll Change! Count on the Change!
eps.ov: The Tree of Hearts has lost all its colors, Cure Moonlight has fallen, and two fairies are forced to flee to look for her replacement. This is what Hanasaki Tsubomi dreams while she moves a new town and new school. But is it just a dream?

eps.t: Am I the Weakest Pretty Cure Ever??
eps.ov: Even after transforming into Cure Blossom, Hanasaki Tsubomi is not capable of controlling her powers. Will Tsubomi be able to save Erika?

eps.t: The Second Pretty Cure is Full of Motivation!
eps.ov: Tsubomi attempts to figure out what it means to be a Cure while trying to help Erika restore the Fashion Club. After revealing she had the same Cure Moonlight dreams, the fairies determine she must be the next Cure.

eps.t: Pretty Cure Combination Dissolves so Fast?
eps.ov: Tsubomi begins to fear that she is a burden to Erika in battle and worries that she will find someone else to replace her.

eps.t: Rejected Ramen! The Family Bond is Reconciled!
eps.ov: Akira Miura believes that his father, who runs a successful ramen shop, cares more about his business than him. However, he is reluctant to talk about it because he does not want to ruin his father's dream.
